text: って　なったら　こわいな…　きみは　へいき　そうな　かお　してるね　いわなだれ…　つかって　みる？

structure.jp: って　なったら　こわいな…
structure.en: if it turned out like that, it'd be scary...

structure.jp: きみは　へいき　そうな　かお　してるね
structure.en: you have a face that looks unbothered

structure.jp: いわなだれ…　つかって　みる？
structure.en: Rock Slide... want to try using it?

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus みる means to try doing it and see. つかって みる = 'try using it'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう after a describing word means 'looks' that way; with な it describes the thing that follows. へいき そうな かお = 'a face that looks unbothered'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら means 'if' that happens; って points back at the scene just described. って なったら = 'if it turned out like that'.
